Describe an upgrade dossier

Source: R/dossier.R
dossier.Rd

A dossier runs the code users learned from a released version (the baseline) unchanged under that version and under a candidate, each installed in its own library, and compares everything the code produces. dossier() only describes the comparison; the stages do the work, each usable alone and each caching its results in the work folder:

Usage

dossier(
  pkg,
  base = cran_release(),
  candidate = local_path("."),
  scenarios = list(from_vignettes(), from_examples()),
  work = file.path(tempdir(), paste0("pkgdossier-", pkg)),
  reps = 3L,
  order = c("abba", "ab"),
  seed = 20261027L,
  reseed = c("step", "scenario"),
  language = "en",
  width = 80L,
  dpi = 100,
  caps = list(),
  skip_classes = default_skip_classes(),
  deps = deps_shared(),
  base_tag = NULL,
  repo = NULL
)

Arguments

pkg

Package name.

base, candidate

Sources, see sources: the release users have (baseline) and the version they would upgrade to (candidate). The candidate defaults to the package folder this is called from, local_path("."); a folder's path is made absolute here, so a later setwd() does not change which folder is meant.

scenarios

A scenario source or a list of them: from_vignettes() (the baseline's vignettes), from_examples() (its help-page examples), both by default, and scenario_file().

work

Work folder holding downloads, builds, libraries, runs and results. Defaults to a folder in tempdir(). A work folder inside a local_path() candidate must be listed in its .Rbuildignore, or R CMD build would copy it into the build.

reps

Timed repeats per timed step in each run. 0 times nothing beyond the captured run (a quick smoke run).

order

"abba" runs base, candidate, candidate, base, so that drift in machine load hits both versions alike and each version runs twice (which is how unseeded steps are found). "ab" runs each version once.

seed

Seed set at the start of every scenario and, with reseed = "step", before every step.

reseed

"step" sets the seed before every step, so a change in how many random numbers one step draws does not move the numbers of later steps: each difference stays where it arises. "scenario" sets it once per scenario, so a vignette that calls set.seed() in one chunk and draws in the next gives the numbers its readers saw. Timed repeats always start from the random-number state of the step's captured run.

language

Value of the LANGUAGE environment variable in the child processes, so that messages and warnings compare across locales. NULL leaves it alone.

width

Console width (options(width)) in the child processes.

dpi

Resolution of the PNG plots.

caps

Size caps for collecting numbers, any of max_depth (nesting depth for visible values, default 6), assign_depth (for assigned objects, 3), max_rows (data-frame rows, 200), max_length (vector length, 200) and max_cells (matrix cells, 400). What a cap skips is reported.

skip_classes

Classes whose objects are not walked when collecting numbers and element names (heavy model fits, plots, environments). See default_skip_classes().

deps

Where the dependencies come from: deps_shared() (the current library paths, the default), deps_cran() (current CRAN versions, in the work folder) or deps_snapshot() (CRAN as on the baseline's release date). See deps.

base_tag

Optional: a git tag to check the baseline's R/ folder against (line endings ignored), and to count the candidate's commits since.

repo

The git repository holding base_tag. Defaults to the candidate's: a git_ref()'s repository, or the git work tree around a local_path() (for a package in a subfolder of its repository, that subfolder is compared). Set it for a tarball or CRAN candidate.

Value

An object of class pkgdossier_dossier.

Details

  1. prepare_versions() fetches, builds and installs both versions;

  2. run_scenarios() runs the scenarios under each version;

  3. compare_runs() compares the runs and labels every difference;

  4. write_dossier_html(), write_dossier_json() and write_dossier_md() write the results.

run_dossier() calls them all. Everything that shapes the runs is set here, so print(d) shows all of it and the stages take only how they run (time limits, workers, whether to ask); the comparison's tolerances belong to compare_runs(), which is cheap to call again on stored runs.

Examples

# describing a dossier reads and downloads nothing
dossier("MAIHDA",
  base = cran_version("0.2.1"),
  candidate = git_ref("path/to/MAIHDA", "main"),
  work = file.path(tempdir(), "dossier-0.3.0")
)
#> <pkgdossier dossier> MAIHDA
#>   base:      CRAN version 0.2.1
#>   candidate: git path/to/MAIHDA @ main
#>   scenarios: baseline vignettes; baseline help-page examples
#>   runs:      abba, 3 timed repeats per timed step, seed 20261027 set per step
#>   capture:   width 80, 100 dpi, LANGUAGE en
#>   collect:   default caps; default skipped classes
#>   deps:      shared, from the current library paths
#>   work:      /tmp/RtmpBg5E3u/dossier-0.3.0

# the whole pipeline, on the small package bundled for examples
# \donttest{
d <- example_dossier()
prepare_versions(d)
#> base: tarball /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/pkgdossier/extdata/udfixture_1.0.0.tar.gz unchanged, reusing the installed copy
#> cand: tarball /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/pkgdossier/extdata/udfixture_1.1.0.tar.gz unchanged, reusing the installed copy
#> base udfixture 1.0.0  sha256 fd0de4ff9fef  packaged 2026-11-06 15:33:45 UTC; root
#> cand udfixture 1.1.0  sha256 0eaefa1ba295  packaged 2026-11-06 15:33:45 UTC; root
run_scenarios(d)
#> Running 3 scenario(s), 30 steps, under udfixture 1.0.0 and 1.1.0 in 4 runs (abba), 3 timed repeats per timed step; a step's run stops after 300 s (step_timeout)
#> Machine before: CPU 0% busy, 0 other R processes
#> [1/4] base_a: up to date, reused
#> [2/4] cand_a: up to date, reused
#> [3/4] cand_b: up to date, reused
#> [4/4] base_b: up to date, reused
cmp <- compare_runs(d)
cmp
#> <pkgdossier comparison> udfixture 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0
#> 3 scenario(s), 28 step(s) compared, 2 not run; abba runs, 3 timed repeats per timed step
#> Verdict: 4 severe changes (field_removed, error_new, argument_new_required, argument_removed); 19 other differences; 1 unstable step; 1 scenario problem.
#> 
#> Differences by kind (severity):
#>   unstable                  0     1 in 1 step(s)
#>   error_new                 1     1 in 1 step(s)
#>   field_removed             1     1 in 1 step(s)
#>   argument_removed          1     1 in 1 step(s)
#>   argument_new_required     1     1 in 1 step(s)
#>   condition_class_changed   2     2 in 2 step(s)
#>   value_moved               2     4 in 4 step(s), 3 distinct
#>   warning_new               2     1 in 1 step(s)
#>   default_changed           2     1 in 1 step(s)
#>   output_changed            3     3 in 3 step(s)
#>   plot_changed              3     1 in 1 step(s)
#>   slower                    3     1 in 1 step(s)
#>   faster                    3     1 in 1 step(s)
#>   warning_gone              4     1 in 1 step(s)
#>   field_added               4     1 in 1 step(s)
#>   error_fixed               4     1 in 1 step(s)
#>   argument_added            4     1 in 1 step(s)
#>   export_added              4     1 in 1 step(s)
#> 
#> NEWS candidates (3 bullet(s) in NEWS.md after 1.0.0): 18 of 24 difference(s) in steps no NEWS bullet names.
#> 
#> 2 difference(s) in udfixture's own DESCRIPTION fields (Version, Packaged, ...), as an example printing sessionInfo() shows them, are not listed.
#> 
#> Coverage: the scenarios use 17 of 18 exported functions. Not used: new_helper.
#> 
#> Scenario problems (error under both versions): api/err_class
#> 
#> Most severe (severity 0-2), identical changes once:
#>   unstable                 api/noisy : differs between runs -> differs between runs  [no NEWS]
#>   field_removed            api/result res$b  [no NEWS]
#>   error_new                api/check error: - -> `x` must be character
#>   argument_new_required    (namespace)/extend_result keep: - -> (required)  [no NEWS]
#>   argument_removed         (namespace)/warn_gone verbose: TRUE -> -  [no NEWS]
#>   value_moved              est$main (2 steps): 0.5 -> 0.6
#>   value_moved              ex_estimate/ex-02 (value): 0.5 -> 0.6
#>   warning_new              api/warn_new warning: - -> results may be unstable  [no NEWS]
#>   condition_class_changed  api/warn_class warning: simpleWarning/warning/condition -> slowWarning/warning/condition  [no NEWS]
#>   condition_class_changed  api/err_class error: simpleError/error/condition -> inputError/error/condition  [no NEWS]
#>   value_moved              api/label lab: alpha -> beta  [no NEWS]
#>   default_changed          (namespace)/report digits: 2 -> 3  [no NEWS]
write_dossier_html(cmp, dir = file.path(tempdir(), "dossier-page"))
